NORTHWIND

DELEGATE CONFIRMATION & ACCESS BRIEFING

YOUR SEAT IS CONFIRMED, ALEX MORGAN

Two days on the Lisbon waterfront with two thousand engineers, forty speakers, and your confirmed access to The Foundry.

The Foundry was built to cast heavy ocean steel. Next March, we gather in its vaulted stone halls to examine what makes software systems weather their own decades: how high-performing teams avoid organizational entropy, why foundational design outlasts marketing cycles, and what happens when software is authored with twenty-year longevity in mind.

Your registration for the Professional tier is officially confirmed. Below you will find your digital boarding credentials, allocated seating block, and fast-track instructions for Day 1.
